already-normalized names, dispatch as before.

test(testing): expand CHIP app placeholders in python script arguments (#4875)

CHIP's python test headers name helper apps with placeholders such as
`--string-arg th_server_app_path:${TV_APP}`. The descriptor generator copied
them verbatim, so TC_SC_4_7 received a literal `${TV_APP}` and failed in
setup ("Error 1, Executed 0"); SC/4.7 was excluded for that reason.

The harness now expands these placeholders when it builds the python
command: `${NAME_APP}` resolves to `/bin/chip-<name>-app` in the test image,
and a placeholder that names no executable there fails the test with
UnresolvedAppPlaceholderError instead of reaching the script.

Expansion happens at run time so it takes effect with the image already
published. The CHIP app-name vocabulary (`${CHIP_LOCK_APP}` -> `lock`) now
lives only in the harness: the generator emits CHIP's app references
verbatim and the harness normalizes them when it loads the descriptor.
Normalizing is idempotent, so descriptors from older images, which carry
already-normalized names, dispatch as before.

SC/4.7 runs again. Its step 7 is skipped under PICS_SDK_CI_ONLY, as in
CHIP's own CI.
